mira.rc: T-25m for the runtime toggle to v3.5. Quick readout + signoffs needed. Posting the mini preflight checklist — please ack your item and call rollback owner if you take it.

mira.rc: ```
PREFLIGHT (T-25 -> T-0)
- config toggle staged in staging and prod-preview ✅ (linus.eng)
- healthcheck probe updated (path /healthz/runtime) ✅ (kevin-sre)
- model artifact pinned: mm_v3_5_quant (anya-ml)
- warmup job queued (5 workers, 30s each) (sam_release)
- deploy ticket: DEP-4821 created and linked ✅ (ops-bot)
- rollback owner assigned and reachable
```

mira.rc: I will coordinate the cut and monitor the dashboard. target rollout window 14:00-14:15 PT.

linus.eng: I staged the toggle and validated config parity. quick smoke in staging shows 0.3% error rate on long sequences. acking my item.

kevin-sre: healthcheck path is live across zones. I'll own rollback. If error rate > 3% for 2 consecutive minutes I'll cut back flag. ping me directly @kevin-sre.

anya-ml: model is pinned, eval ramps look fine for this sequence distribution. note: tokenization tweak is enabled in mm_v3_5_quant — expecting identical logits. ack.

sam_release: warmup jobs queued and verified. one warmup worker failed once (OOM) but restarted; all green now. question: do we need a soft-fallback to 3.4 in route policy or full cut?

mira.rc: good q. plan is soft-fallback to runtime-3.4 model-compat variant first 5 minutes, then full rollback if persistent. linus, can you confirm route policy set?

linus.eng: route policy set to prefer 3.5, fallback to 3.4-compat on error. TTL 30s. ack.

sam_release: ok good. acked.

ops-bot: DEP-4821 | deploy scheduled at 2026-03-17T21:00:00Z by mira.rc. Tags: runtime-toggle, v3.5, warmup, rollback-kevin-sre.

mira.rc: final quick check: everyone OK to go? please react with :white_check_mark: or drop a line if not. rolling at T-0 (14:00 PT).

kevin-sre: :white_check_mark: I am on-call and will watch alarms.

linus.eng: :white_check_mark: ready.

anya-ml: :white_check_mark: watching evals.

sam_release: :white_check_mark: warmup verified.

mira.rc: thanks. starting cut in 5m. I'll post a status update after initial 1% ramp.

(16:04) mira.rc: started 1% lane ramp. monitoring token latency and 5xx rate.

(16:06) mira.rc: 1% lane stable. latency + error within expected delta. proceeding to 10% for 10m.

(16:16) kevin-sre: observed spike to 4.2% errors for 30s at 16:12, recovered to 1.1% quickly. keeping rollback on standby.

(16:20) mira.rc: hitting 100% grad ramp over next 2m. will confirm finalization after 2m steady.

(16:22) mira.rc: rollout complete. no manual rollback. closing DEP-4821. thanks all :tada:
